claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says advanced Taygetan replicators create matter from energy, but exact copies of unfamiliar complex objects still require an original to scan.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes exact replication from designing a similar-looking object.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Taygetan starships carry large engineering replicators that make replacement parts for engines and other systems, reducing dry-dock repairs.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says this gives the ships nearly unlimited range.
